title: Hyperbolic Latent Geometry for Tree-Structured Prototype Networks: A Local-vs-Global Trade-off
abstract: arXiv:2608.25199v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a tree-structured regularizer over class-prototype layouts in a hierarchical-classification model and ask whether the choice of latent manifold for the prototypes (Euclidean R^d vs. the Poincare ball B^d_c) affects how well that regularizer can be satisfied without distorting the data likelihood. The two manifolds differ only in their volume growth: hyperbolic space grows exponentially with radius and embeds trees with provably lower distortion than R^d of matched dimension, so the structured regularizer should be cheaper to satisfy on B^d_c. translated_title: 双曲潜在几何用于树状原型网络：局部与全局的权衡
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了一种在层次分类模型中对类原型布局施加树状结构正则化器的方法，并探讨了原型的潜在流形选择（欧几里得空间R^d与庞加莱球B^d_c）是否会影响在不扭曲数据似然的情况下满足该正则化器的效果。这两种流形仅在体积增长上有所不同：双曲空间随半径呈指数增长，并且与相同维度的R^d相比，能够以可证明的更低失真嵌入树结构，因此结构化正则化器在B^d_c上应更容易满足。通过对WikiArt数据集（27种风格，81,446幅画作，冻结的CLIP ViT-B/16特征）进行150次种子复制的正则化最大似然拟合，覆盖嵌入维度、曲率和正则化强度，我们发现一个稳健的效应：庞加莱原型在潜在空间中保持最近邻图的拓扑结构方面显著优于匹配的欧几里得原型（兄弟召回率）。
tldr: 本文发现，在树状结构原型网络中，使用双曲空间（庞加莱球）比欧几里得空间能更好地保持潜在空间的最近邻拓扑结构，且不损害数据似然，从而在局部与全局权衡中实现更优性能。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that in tree-structured prototype networks, using hyperbolic space (Poincaré ball) better preserves the nearest-neighbor topology in latent space than Euclidean space without harming data likelihood, achieving a superior local-vs-global trade-off.
